items.title: 6.3 Standard enthalpy changes (standard enthalpy ki tabdeeliyan) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.3, printed page 120.

blocks.text: Kisi substance ki enthalpy sirf us ki physical state par nahi balke pressure aur temperature par bhi depend karti hai. Is liye equation likhte waqt yeh conditions (halaat) batana zaroori hai. Alag alag reactions ki enthalpy changes ka sahi comparison (muqabla) karne ke liye ΔH kuch fixed standard conditions mein napa jata hai:

blocks.title: Did you Know (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text:
Kisi element ki standard state us ki woh shakal hai jo 298 K aur 1 atm par sab se zyada stable ho.
Misal: carbon ki standard state graphite hai, diamond nahi. Definition (tareef) ke mutabiq standard state wale kisi bhi element ki standard enthalpy change of formation zero hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Enthalpy changes ka comparison standard conditions mein kyun karte hain, aur O₂ gas ki standard enthalpy of formation kitni hai?
blocks.explanation: Enthalpy temperature, pressure aur physical state par depend karti hai; alag conditions ki values ka comparison theek nahi hota, is liye 298 K aur 1 atm fixed kiye gaye. O₂ gas oxygen ki standard state hai, is liye us ki standard enthalpy of formation zero hai.

items: Standard conditions: 25 °C (298 K) aur 1 atm (101 kPa).
Element ki standard state us ki sab se stable shakal hai (carbon: graphite); us ki ΔH°f zero hai.
